article.story: Old Dominion (2-5) at Louisiana Tech (4-2), Oct. 24 at 5 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Louisiana Tech by 8.5. Against the spread: Louisiana Tech 5-1, Old Dominion 1-6. Louisiana Tech ranks 64th on defense, allowing its opponents at convert at 36.9%. Old Dominion is 99th in the FBS with a -3 turnover margin, compared to Louisiana Tech's 15th-ranked +5 margin. Old Dominion is 112th in the FBS with 68.7 penalty yards per game. Louisiana Tech ranks 118th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 76% of trips. Old Dominion's red zone defense ranks 95th at 87.5%. Old Dominion ranks 123rd in the FBS with an average time of possession of 27:30. Team leaders Louisiana Tech Passing: Blake Baker, 857 yards, 9 TDs, 1 INT, 68.7 completion percentage Rushing: Andrew Burnette, 286 yards on 65 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Jalen Mickens, 476 yards on 32 catches, 3 TDs Old Dominion Passing: Quinn Henicle, 656 yards, 4 TDs, 4 INTs, 55.1 completion percentage Rushing: Devin Roche, 373 yards on 95 carries, 0 TDs Receiving: T.J. Johnson, 262 yards on 16 catches, 3 TDs Last game Louisiana Tech won 24-0 over UL Monroe on Oct. 17. Baker led Louisiana Tech with 178 yards on 15-of-21 passing (71.4%) for two touchdowns and no interceptions. Burnette had 79 rushing yards on 22 carries. Marcus Calwise Jr. had eight receptions for 119 yards. Old Dominion fell to Georgia Southern 23-15 on Oct. 15. Ryan Huff threw for 115 yards on 9-of-14 attempts (64.3%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. Maurki James carried the ball four times for 29 yards. Johnson put up 83 yards on two catches with one touchdown. Next game Louisiana Tech plays at South Alabama on Oct. 31. Old Dominion hosts Marshall on Oct. 31.
